_about: The Keynote 3 (look ported from Ahmed's template-the-keynote, Keynote 3.1, 9 Oct 2026; 6/6 SHIP on hand-planned, brand-checked clips). Extends the fork's `keynote` and leaves it untouched, director block included. What changes: a larger gold script word (serifScale 2.6) and bold word (boldScale 2.2), a gentler punch-in (emphasisScale 1.28), strong caption shadow with no grey box, the previous line settling to a heavier weight, a shorter write-on and alarm hold, and a caption line that never spans a jump cut (captions.breakOnCut). Music stays null (his bed, silent-descent, has no licensed source). NOT ported: face-aware 9:16 crop, face-safe light leaks with sentence-end fallback (leaks.faceSafe and friends), face-size punch-in cap (cadence.faceAnchor), -15 LUFS mastering, and his director additions (selfFromKept, min_treatments_per_30s), which need planner support.
